summary: 5-Stage Recruiting Funnel Testing Complete. All 8 scenarios pass. Backend (14/14 tests), Frontend UI verified.
passed_tests: SCENARIO 1: New school with NO interactions -> needs_outreach (UCLA verified)
SCENARIO 2: School with outreach logged but NO coach reply -> waiting_on_reply (API test)
SCENARIO 3: School with coach_reply (mark-replied) -> in_conversation (Stanford verified)
SCENARIO 4: School with overdue follow-up date (yesterday) -> overdue (API test)
SCENARIO 5: School marked inactive (is_active=false) -> archived (API test)
SCENARIO 6: School with coach_reply AND overdue -> overdue wins (API test - priority order verified)
SCENARIO 7: School with outreach AND future follow-up date -> waiting_on_reply (API test)
SCENARIO 8: School with no interactions but has future follow-up date -> needs_outreach (API test)
Backend: GET /api/programs?grouped=true returns 5 groups: overdue, needs_outreach, waiting_on_reply, in_conversation, archived
Backend: GET /api/programs/{id} returns board_group field with one of 5 values
Backend: POST /api/programs/{id}/mark-replied creates coach_reply interaction and updates signals
Backend: mark-replied requires non-empty note (returns 400 if empty)
Backend: is_active=false -> board_group='archived', is_active=true -> returns to appropriate stage
Frontend Board: GroupFunnel shows 5 tabs with correct counts (All=2, Overdue=0, Needs Outreach=1, Waiting on Reply=0, In Conversation=1, Archived=0)
Frontend Board: Next Step visible in needs_outreach rows (UCLA shows 'Send your first email')
Frontend Board: NO Next Step in in_conversation rows (Stanford shows only 'Journey' button)
Frontend Board: Inline follow-up date badge shows on non-overdue school cards (UCLA showed 'Due Feb 20' badge)
Frontend Journey: NextStepHero shows for needs_outreach school (UCLA shows 'Send your first email to introduce yourself')
Frontend Journey: NO NextStepHero for in_conversation school (Stanford shows only Timeline with 'Coach replied')
seed_data_creation: Test programs created and cleaned up during pytest execution. UCLA and Stanford used for UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 5-stage funnel is fully implemented and working. The NEW stages are: overdue (red), needs_outreach (amber), waiting_on_reply (blue), in_conversation (green), archived (gray). OLD stages (action_required, upcoming, in_progress, closed) are GONE. Next Step cards only appear for overdue, needs_outreach, waiting_on_reply stages on both Board and Journey pages. Inline due date badges appear on school cards in non-overdue stages when next_action_due is set. Priority order: archived > overdue > in_conversation > waiting_on_reply > needs_outreach.

5_stage_funnel.overdue: Schools with past next_action_due date - highest priority after archived
5_stage_funnel.waiting_on_reply: Outreach sent (interaction logged) but no coach_reply

next_step_visibility.board: Shows for overdue, needs_outreach, waiting_on_reply ONLY
next_step_visibility.journey: NextStepHero shows for same 3 stages ONLY

feature_verification.inline_due_badge: Shows on school cards in non-overdue stages when next_action_due is set
